import re
import sys

values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r'\b(TMP|[a-h])\s*<-\s*'
    r'(?:\(\s*(TMP|[a-h])\s*([+-])\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)|(\d+))\s*;'
)

for match in pattern.finditer(sys.stdin.read()):
    target, source, operator, amount, modulus, literal = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        value = values[source]
        amount = int(amount)
        if operator == '-':
            amount = -amount
        values[target] = (value + amount) % int(modulus)

print('; '.join(f'{name} ?= {values[name]}' for name in 'abcdefgh') +
      f"; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
